pre_mortem: It is Monday and both overs lost. Henry: week 1 was more play-action than the late-2025 bellcow role, IND sold out to the run, and a normal 18-20 carry day landed near 80-90, under a number that is already his 17-game median. The 216-yard game made the last four look automatic. If IND led early, the carry script flipped and the leg was dead. Warren: Buchanan's backup covered the seam, IND fed Pierce and Taylor, and Warren finished in the same 19-43 band as his last four, short of 44.5. The injury read was real and the yardage line was still too high. That counter-case is why Warren is flagged rather than sized, and why these two are not forced into one parlay if the human only wants the Henry side.
slip_story: Do not mix them as if they need opposite scripts, and do not force them into one ticket if the human only buys the flagged Warren side. Base script is a competitive BAL win, 25.8-22.8, roof closed: Henry rush over is the favorite-runs-the-clock anchor, and Warren rec over is the separate Buchanan-underneath angle that also survives IND trailing. They split if BAL is chasing (flip 2), so they are not a forced 2-leg. No touchdown legs. No Flowers over, no game over, and no Taylor rush over in the Henry ticket, because a buried-IND flip helps Henry's carries and kills Taylor's. Stake proposal is none until a real price exists.
